title: Provident fund and EPS pension (EPFO)
official: After a member dies, eligible nominees can claim from EPFO. The EPFO website has a "File Death Claim" option that leads to its member portal.
suggestion: Their last employer's HR team may be able to help with the claim.
contact: EPFO, or the HR team of their last employer
confirms: EPFO home page: "File Death Claim - Eligible nominees can claim in case of employee's demise."
